priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. The company believes Everson was granted full access to its books and records, except for materials related to pending litigation involving Toby Neugebauer, whom Everson represented on the Board.

general.summary: Duncan Moir, president & CIO at 21Shares, joins Scarlet Fu and Athanasios Psarofagis on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." 21Shares x FalconX Limited (ticker: CLAU AV) is domiciled in Cayman Islands. The ETN provides synthetic exposure to Anthropic's current market implied valuation, before the company completes its initial public offering (IPO). (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Not Everybody Should Be In ETF Space: Christensen
general.summary: Brittany Christensen, SVP head of business development at Tidal Financial Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Athanasios Psarofagis on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss mutual funds and the rapid pace of ETF launches. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Instacart to Wind Down Smart Cart Business Amid Sale Talks
general.summary: Instacart will stop offering high-tech shopping carts to grocers, its first announced strategy shift since reports emerged that the company is in talks to sell itself.

general.title: Intel to Buy Israeli Startup Classiq in Quantum Computing Push
general.summary: Intel Corp. agreed to buy Israeli startup Classiq Technologies Ltd. as part of a push to capitalize on quantum computing, a still-nascent field that is seeking commercial applications.

general.title: Moderna CEO Sees Cancer Vaccines Working Beyond Melanoma
general.summary: Moderna CEO Stephane Bancel believes the personalized mRNA cancer vaccine being developed with Merck will work in a variety of tumors. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Bancel also says the recent data leak for the cancer vaccine candidate did not come from either Moderna or Merck. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals $542B Data Center Spend Plan - The Tech Buzz
Anthropic Drops Its S-1, Giving Market Glimpse Into Finances
general.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic's regulatory filing as the company prepares to go public under the ticker ANT. The S-1 revealed Anthropic's revenue and spending, along with its plan for an unusual corporate structure. Plus, venture investors are in line for a big payday when Anthropic goes public. Matt Murphy from Menlo Ventures and Byron Deeter from Bessemer Venture Partners discuss what they think happens next for the AI market. (Source: Bloomberg)
